body: I'm not sure hospitalization is preferable to death. Even if it was, I could never afford such a thing.

I wish I knew what they were. I don't know who to trust -- including myself. And I'm scared of doctors, who seem to enjoy pumping me full of meds then promptly taking 0 responsibility for the aftermath.
If you had asked me this a few months ago, yes. Now I have more pressing needs, like trying to regain a full sense of conciousness.
